query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ghost_variety_plant_links (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  ghost_variety_id INT NOT NULL,
  plant_id INT NOT NULL,
  relationship_type ENUM('parent_species', 'related_variety', 'hybrid_parent', 'descendant', 'comparison', 'reconstruction_base', 'other') DEFAULT 'parent_species',
  confidence ENUM('high', 'medium', 'low') DEFAULT 'medium',
  genetic_similarity INT,
  notes TEXT,
  source_reference TEXT,
  created_by INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX gv_plant_link_variety_idx (ghost_variety_id),
  INDEX gv_plant_link_plant_idx (plant_id),
  UNIQUE INDEX unique_gv_plant (ghost_variety_id, plant_id)
);
